intro.greeting: Hello Friends and Members of Chorlton Bikes,
paragraphs: We're really glad you're here. This newsletter is a chance to share what we've been up to - our riders, our partners, and the difference we're making together in Chorlton and beyond.
July has been a busy month of new delivery partnerships, community events and exciting additions to our bike library. Here's what we've been up to.

monthIntro: From pizza deliveries on Deansgate to coffee briquettes, a school bike bus and a new e-cargo bike for families, July has been full of zero-emissions momentum across Greater Manchester.

sections.title: Pizza Pilgrims
bullets: 🍕 We've started delivering for Pizza Pilgrims, a new pizza restaurant on Deansgate who want to use our zero-emissions service for their catering deliveries.
🍕 If you know a workplace or event that needs a stack of delicious pizzas, get in touch with Pizza Pilgrims and we'll deliver!

cta.label: Know somewhere that needs pizza deliveries? Get in touch

images.alt: Chorlton Bikes pizza delivery for Pizza Pilgrims

sections.title: Wythenshawe Live leaflets
bullets: 🎵 We're preparing to deliver leaflets for Wythenshawe Live music festival to local residents in the Wythenshawe area.
🎵 They've used us for this job for the last few years, and we're grateful that they remain committed to zero-emissions deliveries on their project.

sections.title: Brewcycle partnership update
bullets: ☕ The guys at Brewcycle have another coffee-grounds related dream! This time they're using the grounds we collect from local coffee shops and bars to manufacture coffee briquettes for commercial and domestic heating.
☕ We've extended the coffee collection to Volta on Burton Road and City Tower in Piccadilly.
☕ Email Jay to find out more.

cta.label: Find out more about the Brewcycle partnership

sections.title: Trishaw support for Oswald Road Bike Bus
bullets: 🚲 Tom Donald borrowed the trishaw for the Oswald Road Primary School bike bus.
🚲 They transported a guitarist who played for the riders!
🚲 If you want to use the trishaw for a community event or hire it for a private event, please get in touch.

cta.label: Hire a trishaw for your community or private event

images.alt: Trishaw supporting the Oswald Road Primary School bike bus

sections.title: Exciting cargo bike news!
bullets: 🚚 We have a new addition to our bike library - an e-cargo bike purchased with grant funds from TfGM.
🚚 We'll soon be promoting it as part of our library, particularly aimed at young families thanks to a great seating fixture on the bike.

cta.label: Interested in borrowing from our bike library? Get in touch

sections.title: Green Roots, Global Voices at Cafe Bembe
bullets: 🌍 Despite some very unpredictable weather, Reg and Peter had a great day at the Green Roots, Global Voices event at Cafe Bembe in Alexandra Park.
🌍 It was a fantastic opportunity to talk to people about Chorlton Bikes, share what we do, and make new connections.
🌍 We're hopeful that we inspired a few people to join the co-op - and perhaps even sparked the interest of a couple of local councillors too!

images.alt: Chorlton Bikes at Green Roots, Global Voices, Cafe Bembe

paragraphs: Thank you to everyone for the continued energy, care and commitment that keeps Chorlton Bikes moving forward - from new delivery partners to community events and our growing bike library.
Whether you're riding, volunteering, donating, or simply spreading the word, you're helping us build a stronger and more connected community. 🚲💚
